content.short: Range Protocol is a universal on-chain asset management platform enabling automated and customized DeFi strategies for individuals and institutions on Mantle.
content.description: Range Protocol is an on-chain asset management platform allowing users and institutions to deploy, manage, and track automated DeFi investment strategies including concentrated liquidity management, yield farming, and delta-neutral positions. The platform has received EcoFund support from Mantle and provides key infrastructure for institutional DeFi participants on the network seeking programmatic, risk-managed exposure to on-chain yields.
